sql: CREATE TABLE schedules (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, nature TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'remind', date_local TEXT NOT NULL, time_local TEXT, advance_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chat', settled_at TEXT, settled_reason TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE schedule_events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, schedule_id TEXT, actor TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, before_json TEXT, after_json TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);
